stories.headline: Free Folklife Fest Returns With 250,000 of Your Closest Friends
stories.body: The 55th Annual Northwest Folklife Festival takes over Seattle Center May 22–25, celebrating this year's cultural theme of Ubuntu — the idea that our humanity is rooted in our connections to one another. Expect drum circles, barefoot dancing, a funky sunset dance party at the Mural Amphitheatre on Sunday, and an Antifascist Yiddish Sing-Along on Saturday. Admission is free (donations warmly welcomed; suggested $20/person).

stories.headline: The Phantom Haunts Paramount — Catch Him Before He Vanishes
stories.body: The Phantom of the Opera glides into the historic Paramount Theatre with performances running through late May, including a Friday night show on May 22. This beloved Andrew Lloyd Webber classic promises all the swooping chandelier drama Seattle's grand dame of a theater was built for.
stories.location: Paramount Theatre, Downtown · May 22 and additional dates

stories.headline: Pancakes, Penguins, and Pure Joy at Woodland Park Zoo
stories.body: Woodland Park Zoo is hosting weekend pancake breakfasts right next to its penguin habitat — and yes, a zookeeper makes an appearance. The event runs May 16–17 AND May 23–24 at 8:30am, meaning you've still got next weekend to snag your spot. Tickets are $72 and include carousel rides and full zoo admission after breakfast.
stories.location: Woodland Park Zoo, Phinney Ridge · May 23–24, 8:30am

stories.headline: SAM's 'Beyond Mysticism' Takes PNW Art Off the Pedestal
stories.body: The Seattle Art Museum's ongoing exhibition Beyond Mysticism spotlights Pacific Northwest artists and art of the 20th century, running Wednesdays through Sundays through September 27, 2026. Free guided public tours are offered every Thursday and weekend, diving deep into artwork crafted right in our backyard. Admission runs $12–$20.
stories.location: Seattle Art Museum, Downtown · Wed–Sun through Sept 27

stories.headline: Storm Season Heats Up: Connecticut Sun Visits Climate Pledge
stories.body: The Seattle Storm tip off their home schedule against the Connecticut Sun on Friday, May 22 at 7:00pm at Climate Pledge Arena. After a Winter Olympics buzz, Seattle's WNBA squad is primed to bring the energy — grab your teal and get loud.
stories.location: Climate Pledge Arena, Uptown · Friday, May 22 at 7:00pm

stories.headline: Sail Elliott Bay on the Schooner Bay Lady All Summer Long
stories.body: Through October 31, 2026, you can board the tall ship schooner Bay Lady for a two-hour voyage across postcard-perfect Elliott Bay, departing from Seattle's Tall Ship at 2201 Alaskan Way. Snacks and drinks are sold onboard, and prices vary by date — ideal for a breezy Sunday escape with that rare May sunshine.
stories.location: Seattle Waterfront (2201 Alaskan Way) · Through Oct 31, dates vary
